agent_skills.x-description: Per-agent-type skill set assignments (e.g. { "gsd-executor": "backend" }) that scope which skills are available to a given agent type.

agent_skills_security.trusted_global_roo.x-description: Filesystem root paths trusted to supply global agent skills without an additional confirmation prompt.

brave_search.x-description: Enable Brave web search for the research agent (requires a BRAVE_API_KEY).

capabilities.auto_update.x-description: Automatically update installed optional capabilities when a newer gsd-core version is detected.

capabilities.strict_known_registries.x-description: Host-based allowlist gating which sources third-party capabilities may be installed from. null permits external installs through the consent + integrity gate; [] blocks all external installs; a non-empty list permits only sources whose host matches an entry (add the literal token "npm" to permit the npm source kind).

claude_md_assembly.blocks.x-description: Named CLAUDE.md assembly block overrides — per-section content injected into the generated CLAUDE.md.

claude_md_assembly.mode.x-description: How managed CLAUDE.md sections are written when the project CLAUDE.md is regenerated.

embed.x-description: Inline content between GSD markers; the default.

link.x-description: Write @.planning/<source-path> references instead; Claude Code expands them at runtime, reducing CLAUDE.md size.

claude_md_path.x-description: Relative path to this project's CLAUDE.md file that GSD reads for project-specific instructions.

code_quality.fallow.enabled.x-description: Enable the Fallow code-quality analysis pass during phase execution.

code_quality.fallow.mcp.x-description: Use the Fallow MCP server (if available) instead of the CLI for code-quality analysis.

code_quality.fallow.scope.x-description: Scope of the Fallow code-quality pass: "phase" analyzes only files touched this phase.

phase.x-description: Analyze only the files touched this phase (default).

commit_docs.x-description: Commit .planning/ artifacts to git after each plan (automatically false if .planning/ is gitignored).

context.x-description: Execution context profile that adjusts agent behavior, e.g. "dev", "research", or "review".

context_window.x-description: Context window size in tokens for spawned agents; use 1000000 for 1M-context models.

dynamic_routing.x-description: Failure-tier escalation config: when enabled, resolves a model from a tier-mapped table and escalates one tier on orchestrator-detected soft failure.

effort.agent_overrides.x-description: Per-agent reasoning-effort overrides (e.g. { "gsd-executor": "low" }), taking precedence over routing_tier_defaults.

effort.default.x-description: Default reasoning-effort tier applied when no phase-type or agent-specific override matches.

minimal.x-description: Lowest reasoning effort — fastest, least thorough.

low.x-description: Low reasoning effort for simple tasks.

high.x-description: High reasoning effort for substantive tasks.

xhigh.x-description: Extra-high reasoning effort for deep reasoning.

max.x-description: Maximum reasoning effort — slowest, most thorough.

effort.routing_tier_defaults.x-description: Default reasoning-effort tier per routing tier (light, standard, heavy).

exa_search.x-description: Enable Exa semantic search for the research agent (requires an EXA_API_KEY).

executor.stall_detect_interval_minutes.x-description: How often, in minutes, the executor checks a running task for signs of being stalled.

executor.stall_threshold_minutes.x-description: Minutes of no progress before the executor treats a running task as stalled.

fast_mode.agent_overrides.x-description: Per-agent overrides for whether Fast Mode (reduced-ceremony execution) is active.

fast_mode.enabled.x-description: Master toggle for Fast Mode, a reduced-ceremony execution path for small or simple work.

fast_mode.routing_tier_defaults.x-description: Default Fast Mode on/off per routing tier (light, standard, heavy).

features.x-description: Arbitrary future feature-flag overrides beyond the two built-in features.* toggles.

features.global_learnings.x-description: Inject global learnings from ~/.gsd/learnings/ into agent prompts.

features.thinking_partner.x-description: Enable conditional extended thinking at workflow decision points (discuss-phase, plan-phase).

firecrawl.x-description: Enable Firecrawl page scraping for the research agent (requires a FIRECRAWL_API_KEY).

gates.confirm_breakdown.x-description: Ask for confirmation before breaking a phase down into individual plans.

gates.confirm_phases.x-description: Ask for confirmation before finalizing the phase list in ROADMAP.md.

gates.confirm_plan.x-description: Ask for confirmation before starting execution of a generated PLAN.md.

gates.confirm_project.x-description: Ask for confirmation before finalizing the initial PROJECT.md during project setup.

gates.confirm_roadmap.x-description: Ask for confirmation before finalizing the generated ROADMAP.md.

gates.confirm_transition.x-description: Ask for confirmation before marking a phase complete and moving to the next one.

gates.execute_next_plan.x-description: Ask for confirmation before starting the next plan within a phase.

gates.issues_review.x-description: Ask for confirmation before proceeding past an open-issues review.

git.base_branch.x-description: Target branch for PRs and merges; auto-detects from origin/HEAD when unset.

git.branching_strategy.x-description: Git branching approach for phase/milestone isolation: "none", "phase", or "milestone".

none.x-description: Commit directly on the current branch; no isolation (default).

phase.x-description: One branch per phase, merged when the phase completes.

milestone.x-description: One branch per milestone, merged when the milestone completes.

git.create_tag.x-description: Create a git tag when a milestone completes.

git.milestone_branch_template.x-description: Branch naming template used when git.branching_strategy is "milestone" (supports {milestone}, {slug}).

git.phase_branch_template.x-description: Branch naming template used when git.branching_strategy is "phase" (supports {phase}, {slug}).

git.quick_branch_template.x-description: Optional branch naming template for quick-task runs (supports {slug}).

granularities.x-description: Per-phase-type overrides of planning granularity (e.g. deeper planning for execution than for research).

granularity.x-description: Default planning depth for phase plans: "coarse", "standard", or "fine".

coarse.x-description: Fewer, larger plans per milestone (2-4 phases); fastest, least detail.

standard.x-description: One plan per phase; the balanced default.

fine.x-description: Task-level plans with the most detail (6-10 phases per milestone).

graphify.auto_update.x-description: Automatically rebuild the knowledge graph when tracked planning artifacts change.

graphify.build_timeout.x-description: Timeout in seconds for a knowledge-graph build or rebuild.

graphify.graph_path.x-description: Override where /gsd-graphify reads the knowledge graph from — point at a shared umbrella-level graph.json so one curated cross-repo graph serves every sub-project. When unset, behaviour is the historical .planning/graphs/graph.json.

hooks.context_warnings.x-description: Show warnings when the estimated context budget for a workflow step is exceeded.

hooks.workflow_guard.x-description: Enable the workflow-guard hook that steers direct file edits back through a GSD command.

jina.x-description: Enable Jina reader/scrape fallback in the discovery waterfall. Defaults to available (true); set false to disable.

learnings.max_inject.x-description: Maximum number of global learning entries injected into agent prompts per session.

manager.flags.discuss.x-description: Extra CLI flags passed to /gsd-discuss-phase when dispatched from the manager (e.g. "--auto --analyze").

manager.flags.execute.x-description: Extra CLI flags passed to the execute workflow when dispatched from the manager.

manager.flags.plan.x-description: Extra CLI flags passed to the plan workflow when dispatched from the manager.

mempalace.memory_mode.x-description: Memory mode for Mempalace: 'augment' (enhances context), 'kg_backend' (knowledge-graph backend), or 'replace' (replaces session memory).

mode.x-description: Operation mode: "interactive" shows gates and confirmations; "yolo" runs autonomously without prompts.

interactive.x-description: Confirm each phase transition interactively; the default.

yolo.x-description: Auto-approve all decisions; runs autonomously without prompts.

model_overrides.x-description: Per-agent model overrides (e.g. { "gsd-executor": "opus" }) — the highest-precedence layer in model resolution, above model_profile and models.

model_policy.budget.x-description: Cost tier used to materialize the canonical model mapping for the chosen provider: "high", "medium", or "low".

high.x-description: Highest-cost tier — the strongest models available for the provider.

null.x-description: Unset — no explicit budget tier selected.

model_policy.high.x-description: Model ID assigned to the high-cost tier (used by the generic-provider path).

model_policy.low.x-description: Model ID assigned to the low-cost tier (used by the generic-provider path).

model_policy.medium.x-description: Model ID assigned to the medium-cost tier (used by the generic-provider path).

model_policy.provider.x-description: AI provider used for model_policy tier resolution (e.g. anthropic, openai, google, qwen).

generic.x-description: Treats all model IDs as opaque strings — no prefix inference or reasoning-effort defaults.

model_policy.runtime_tiers.x-description: Per-runtime, per-tier model ID overrides layered under model_policy.

model_profile.x-description: Model selection preset applied to all subagents: "quality", "balanced", "budget", "adaptive", or "inherit".

quality.x-description: Opus for all decision-making; highest quality.

balanced.x-description: Opus for planning only; Sonnet for execution (default).

budget.x-description: Sonnet for code-writing; Haiku for the rest.

inherit.x-description: All agents use the current session model.

model_profile_overrides.x-description: Per-runtime overrides of the built-in opus/sonnet/haiku model IDs GSD resolves for each profile tier.

models.x-description: Coarse per-phase-type model tier map (planning, discuss, research, execution, verification, completion) for tuning without learning the full agent taxonomy.

parallelization.x-description: Enable parallel wave execution across independent plans within a phase. Accepts a plain boolean or an object with an "enabled" field plus the sub-keys below.

parallelization.enabled.x-description: Master toggle for parallel wave execution when parallelization is set as an object.

parallelization.max_concurrent_agents.x-description: Maximum number of executor agents allowed to run concurrently across all parallel plans.

parallelization.min_plans_for_parallel.x-description: Minimum number of eligible plans in a wave before GSD switches from sequential to parallel execution.

parallelization.plan_level.x-description: Allow independent plans within the same wave to execute in parallel.

parallelization.skip_checkpoints.x-description: Skip interactive checkpoints for plans running in parallel, so a paused checkpoint in one plan doesn't block sibling plans.

parallelization.task_level.x-description: Allow independent tasks within the same plan to execute in parallel.

perplexity.x-description: Enable Perplexity web search in the discovery waterfall (requires a PERPLEXITY_API_KEY).

phase_id_convention.x-description: Optional override for how phase identifiers are formatted, when phase_naming allows customization.

milestone-prefixed.x-description: Globally unique IDs that encode the enclosing milestone (e.g. Phase 1-01).

null.x-description: Unset — legacy numeric phase IDs (Phase 1, Phase 2).

phase_naming.x-description: Phase numbering scheme: "sequential" auto-increments; "custom" allows arbitrary string IDs.

plan_review.source_grounding.x-description: Require plan review to ground each claim against the actual source files before approving a plan.

plan_review.source_grounding_authority.x-description: Tool used to verify source-grounding claims during plan review (e.g. "grep").

grep.x-description: Ripgrep/grep search of source files; works in any project without additional tooling (default).

intel.x-description: Query the .planning/intel/api-map.json index built by /gsd:map-codebase; requires intel.enabled.

treesitter.x-description: Reserved for a future tree-sitter adapter.

lsp.x-description: Reserved for a future LSP adapter.

scip.x-description: Reserved for a future SCIP/LSIF adapter.

planning.commit_docs.x-description: Nested alias for the top-level commit_docs setting; if both are set, the top-level value takes precedence.

planning.search_gitignored.x-description: Nested alias for the top-level search_gitignored setting; if both are set, the top-level value takes precedence.

planning.sub_repos.x-description: Auto-detected list of child directories with their own .git repository, kept in sync on every config load.

project_code.x-description: Short prefix used in generated phase directory names (e.g. "CK" produces CK-01-foundation).

ref_search.x-description: Enable Ref docs search in the discovery waterfall (requires a REF_API_KEY).

resolve_model_ids.x-description: Whether to map model tier aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) to full Claude model IDs; "omit" returns an empty model parameter so the runtime's own default is used.

false.x-description: Return Claude aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku) — the default.

true.x-description: Map aliases to full Claude model IDs (e.g. claude-opus-4-8).

omit.x-description: Return an empty model parameter so the runtime uses its own default; set automatically for non-Claude runtimes.

response_language.x-description: Language for user-facing questions and prompts across all phases and subagents (e.g. "Portuguese", "Japanese").

review.default_reviewers.x-description: Default list of reviewer CLIs used by /gsd-review when none are specified on the command line.

review.llama_cpp_host.x-description: Host URL for a local llama.cpp server used as a review reviewer backend.

review.lm_studio_host.x-description: Host URL for a local LM Studio server used as a review reviewer backend.

review.max_prompt_tokens.x-description: Maximum prompt size, in tokens, sent to any single review reviewer.

review.max_prompt_tokens_per_reviewer.x-description: Per-reviewer-slug override of the maximum prompt token budget.

review.models.x-description: Per-CLI model override for /gsd-review (e.g. review.models.gemini); falls back to that CLI's own default when unset.

review.ollama_host.x-description: Host URL for a local Ollama server used as a review reviewer backend.

review.reviewer_instances.x-description: Named reviewer instances — run one model-capable adapter as several independent reviewers (each with its own cli/model/agent).

runtime.x-description: Which AI runtime GSD is installed for (e.g. "claude", "codex", "gemini"); drives built-in model-tier defaults.

safety.always_confirm_destructive.x-description: Always ask for confirmation before a destructive operation (e.g. force-push, branch delete, file overwrite), regardless of mode.

safety.always_confirm_external_services.x-description: Always ask for confirmation before calling an external or paid service (e.g. search APIs), regardless of mode.

search_gitignored.x-description: Include gitignored paths in broad ripgrep searches by adding --no-ignore.

security.injection_blocking.x-description: Block prompt-injection patterns detected in content read from external or untrusted sources during agent runs.

ship.pr_body_sections.x-description: Append-only project-specific PR body sections rendered by /gsd-ship, in addition to the required core sections.

statusline.context_position.x-description: Where the context-usage indicator renders in the terminal status line (e.g. "end").

end.x-description: Render the context indicator at the end of the status line (default).

front.x-description: Render the context indicator at the front of the status line.

statusline.show_context_tokens.x-description: Append the absolute token count (e.g. (156k)) after the context meter's percentage in the status line.

statusline.show_git.x-description: Append a git segment after the directory in the status line: current branch plus compact work-state markers (+staged ~unstaged ?untracked).

statusline.show_last_command.x-description: Show the last-run GSD command in the terminal status line.

statusline.state_format.x-description: Choose how much workflow state the terminal status line shows.

full.x-description: Show the complete state summary, including the current workflow details.

compact.x-description: Show a shorter state summary to keep the status line less crowded.

tavily_search.x-description: Enable Tavily web search in the discovery waterfall (requires a TAVILY_API_KEY).

workflow.auto_advance.x-description: Automatically advance to the next phase after the current one completes, without waiting for confirmation.

workflow.auto_prune_state.x-description: Automatically prune old STATE.md entries at phase boundaries, keeping the most recent phases.

workflow.build_command.x-description: Custom shell command run as the build gate by the post-merge gate; auto-detected or skipped when unset.

workflow.code_review_command.x-description: External code-review command that receives the diff via stdin, integrated into /gsd-ship in place of the built-in review flow.

workflow.code_review_depth.x-description: Default depth for code review when no --depth override is supplied.

quick.x-description: Run a lightweight review for obvious correctness issues and high-signal cleanup opportunities.

standard.x-description: Run the default balanced review depth for normal phase work.

deep.x-description: Run a more exhaustive review that spends more time on edge cases, integration risks, and subtle bugs.

workflow.context_coverage_gate.x-description: Require the context-budget coverage check to pass before advancing a wave.

workflow.context_guard_mode.x-description: Context-exhaustion guard mode for execute-phase: "warn" recommends a pause, "auto" pauses automatically, "off" disables the guard.

warn.x-description: Emit a warning and recommend /gsd:pause-work when context pressure is poor (default).

auto.x-description: Automatically invoke /gsd:pause-work before the next wave.

workflow.cross_ai_command.x-description: Shell command that delegates phase execution to an external AI CLI, receiving the phase prompt via stdin.

workflow.cross_ai_execution.x-description: Delegate phase execution to an external AI CLI instead of local executor agents.

workflow.cross_ai_timeout.x-description: Timeout in seconds for a delegated cross-AI execution run.

workflow.discuss_mode.x-description: Default mode for discuss-phase: "discuss" runs interactive questioning; "assumptions" analyzes the codebase and surfaces assumptions instead.

assumptions.x-description: Reads the codebase first, generates structured assumptions with confidence levels, and only asks you to correct what is wrong.

workflow.drift_action.x-description: Action taken by the codebase drift gate when the threshold is exceeded: warn (advisory) or auto-remap (trigger gsd-codebase-mapper).

warn.x-description: Report codebase drift as an advisory warning so the user can decide whether to remap context.

auto-remap.x-description: Automatically trigger a codebase remap when drift exceeds the configured threshold.

workflow.human_verify_mode.x-description: When to pause execution for human verification (e.g. "end-of-phase").

end-of-phase.x-description: Suppress checkpoint:human-verify tasks and embed checks into end-of-phase review (default).

mid-flight.x-description: Restore blocking checkpoint tasks during execution.

workflow.inline_plan_threshold.x-description: Plans with this many tasks or fewer execute inline instead of spawning a subagent, avoiding spawn overhead for small plans.

workflow.max_discuss_passes.x-description: Maximum number of discuss-phase question rounds before the discussion loop stops (prevents infinite loops in headless mode).

workflow.mvp_mode.x-description: Persist the MVP-mode flag so every phase defaults to MVP framing (a UI-to-API-to-DB vertical slice) without requiring --mvp on the CLI.

workflow.node_repair.x-description: Attempt automatic repair of a failed plan task before giving up.

workflow.node_repair_budget.x-description: Maximum number of automatic repair attempts per failed task.

workflow.plan_bounce.x-description: Pipe each generated PLAN.md through an external validator script and block on non-zero exit.

workflow.plan_bounce_passes.x-description: Number of plan-bounce validation passes to run.

workflow.plan_bounce_script.x-description: Path to the external plan-bounce validation script; receives the PLAN.md path as its first argument.

workflow.plan_check.x-description: Run the plan-checker agent to validate generated plans before execution.

workflow.plan_chunked.x-description: Split planning into a short outline pass followed by several short per-plan passes, each committed individually — useful where long-lived planning tasks can hang.

workflow.plan_review_convergence.x-description: Iterate cross-AI plan review until concerns converge and resolve, instead of a single review pass.

workflow.research_before_questions.x-description: Run research before the interactive question round in discuss-phase.

workflow.security_block_on.x-description: Minimum open threat severity that blocks phase advancement.

critical.x-description: Block phase completion only when critical security findings remain open.

high.x-description: Block phase completion for unresolved high or critical security findings.

medium.x-description: Block phase completion for unresolved medium, high, or critical security findings.

low.x-description: Block phase completion for any unresolved security finding, including low severity.

none.x-description: Do not block phase completion on security findings; report them as advisory follow-up instead.

workflow.specless_probe_fallback.x-description: Enable the spec-less probe fallback so a plan with no explicit spec still probes for a design contract. Any value other than literal false enables it.

workflow.subagent_timeout.x-description: Timeout in milliseconds for parallel subagent tasks (e.g. codebase mapping).

workflow.test_command.x-description: Custom shell command run as the regression/test gate; auto-detected (Makefile, package.json, Cargo.toml, go.mod, pyproject.toml) when unset.

workflow.test_gate_timeout.x-description: Wall-clock timeout in seconds for a verification test gate; a watch-mode runner that never exits is aborted after this budget instead of hanging the orchestrator.

workflow.text_mode.x-description: Use plain-text numbered lists instead of interactive menus for all prompts.

workflow.use_worktrees.x-description: Run executor agents in isolated git worktrees instead of sequentially on the main working tree.

workflow.verifier.x-description: Run the verifier agent after execution to confirm the phase's goals were met.

workflow.worktree_skip_hooks.x-description: Skip git hooks when creating or operating on executor worktrees.

claude_orchestration.enabled.x-description: When enabled, activates Claude-level orchestration for planning and execution workflows within this GSD project.

claude_orchestration.execution_backend.x-description: Selects the execution backend for Claude orchestration: 'auto' (automatic selection), 'inline' (embedded execution), or 'workflow' (dedicated workflow mode).

claude_orchestration.min_agent_sdk_versi.x-description: Minimum agent SDK version required for Claude orchestration features to function correctly.

external_job.enabled.x-description: Enables running GSD tasks as external jobs (e.g., via Slurm or other batch systems) rather than inline execution.

external_job.backend.x-description: The backend system for external job submission (e.g., 'slurm', 'k8s', 'local').

external_job.artifact_dir.x-description: Directory where external job artifacts are stored after execution.

external_job.poll_timeout_ms.x-description: Timeout in milliseconds for polling external job status before considering it stalled.

external_job.submit_timeout_ms.x-description: Timeout in milliseconds for the initial job submission request.

graphify.enabled.x-description: When enabled, activates the project knowledge graph build and update for this GSD project.

intel.enabled.x-description: Enables the intel tracking and analysis module for this project.

mempalace.enabled.x-description: When enabled, activates the Mempalace memory and cross-project tunnel system for this project.

mempalace.wing.x-description: The wing identifier for Mempalace session isolation and cross-project tunnel routing.

mempalace.recall_on_discuss.x-description: When enabled, Mempalace recalls relevant memories during the discuss phase.

mempalace.recall_on_plan.x-description: When enabled, Mempalace recalls relevant memories during the plan phase.

mempalace.capture_artifacts.x-description: When enabled, Mempalace captures phase artifacts into its temporal knowledge graph.

mempalace.mirror_kg.x-description: When enabled, mirrors the temporal knowledge graph for cross-session continuity.

mempalace.cross_project_tunnels.x-description: When enabled, allows cross-project tunnel connections through Mempalace.

mempalace.diary_journal.x-description: When enabled, keeps a session diary journal as part of Mempalace.

mempalace.auto_capture_hooks.x-description: When enabled, automatically captures artifacts via hook triggers.

profile-pipeline.enabled.x-description: When enabled, activates the profile pipeline for managing agent and model profile configurations.

workflow.ai_integration_phase.x-description: When enabled, activates AI integration phase for this GSD workflow.

workflow.api_coverage_gate.x-description: When enabled, requires API coverage verification before workflow advancement.

workflow.assumption_delta.x-description: Tracks delta in assumptions during the discuss phase.

workflow.code_review.x-description: When enabled, activates the code review step in the workflow.

workflow.drift_threshold.x-description: Threshold for detecting configuration drift (number of changed keys before a warning).

workflow.nyquist_validation.x-description: When enabled, activates Nyquist validation for this workflow phase.

workflow.pattern_mapper.x-description: When enabled, activates the pattern mapper step.

workflow.plan_drift_precheck.x-description: When enabled, performs a pre-check for plan drift before execution.

workflow.post_planning_gaps.x-description: When enabled, analyzes and reports gaps after the planning phase completes.

workflow.research.x-description: When enabled, activates the research phase.

workflow.schema_drift_gate.x-description: When enabled, blocks advancement on schema drift.

workflow.schema_push_detection.x-description: When enabled, detects and reports schema push events.

workflow.security_asvs_level.x-description: ASVS security level for security enforcement (number 1-3).

workflow.security_enforcement.x-description: When enabled, activates security enforcement for this workflow.

workflow.tdd_mode.x-description: When enabled, requires failing tests before fixes (red-green-done cycle).

workflow.ui_phase.x-description: When enabled, activates the UI design contract phase.

workflow.ui_review.x-description: When enabled, activates the UI visual audit review phase.

workflow.ui_safety_gate.x-description: When enabled, activates the UI safety gate before final approval.

workflow.windows_enforce.x-description: When enabled, enforces Windows-specific rules or configurations.
